notes.title: Early Access Patch 0.2.7
notes.content: [h2]ESA SHIELD Mission Update[/h2][p]Hello Space Safety Commander![/p][p]The last weeks have been crazy. From our early access release, to Gamescom, to the week when you're just happen to be sick. Thanks to each and all of you who visited our booth, gave us some great feedback in person, as a review, on Discord or discussion, and in generally just played the game.[/p][p]Now that we have recharged our batteries and are feeling fit again, we have a little Patch for you. Mainly minor bug fixes and quality of life improvements, here we have a small list of our additions:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Improvements [/b]🔧[/h3][list][*][p]Grid Hardening protection lines are now visible from further away.[/p][/*][*][p]Grid Hardening protection range is now visualized.[/p][/*][*][p]Grid Hardening protection on entities suffering from a system failure will first repair the failure before providing protection.[/p][/*][*][p]Added keybinds [b]1, 2, 3, 4[/b] to open the relevant windows.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased auto-rotate speed when moving a building blueprint to the edge of the Earth.[/p][/*][*][p]Building blueprints are now colored red when placement is not possible.[/p][/*][*][p]Building construction is now prohibited within existing buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Pop-up windows of buildings (e.g., telescope) no longer block the view of the building.[/p][/*][*][p]Added button descriptions in building pop-up windows (e.g., Level Up, Shutdown).[/p][/*][*][p]Additional Research Facilities are now affected by CME hits.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly adjusted UI and game background colors.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed space coverage money rewards from [b]10% steps[/b] to [b]5% steps[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the Tech Tree button from the top UI. Added a new [b]Research[/b] button to the side tab to open the Tech Tree.[/p][/*][*][p]Added buttons for rotating the Earth and zooming. These can be activated in the Accessibility tab in the settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved main menu support for ultrawide monitors (further actions for ultrawide support pending).[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug fixes [/b]🐞[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where VFX would not turn off.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the space coverage sphere was not always activated and generally improved the toggle button.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Grid Hardening protection lines were only visible from the side (render distance of lines improved).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Solar Flares/CMEs could get stuck inside the Earth.[/p][/*][/list][p]Do you have any more feedback or have you discovered a new bug? Then join our Discord and let us know! Back to the control room for us – see you soon![/p]

notes.title: Early Access Release - v.0.2.0
notes.content:
[p]Welcome Space Commander![/p][p]To accompany the start of the Gamescom with the Opening Night Live and the Steam Event, we are happy to release ESA Shield to Early Access.[/p][h3]Your mission is crucial! [/h3][p]Protect Earth and infrastructure from real cosmic hazards and threats such as asteroids, solar storms, and space debris.

The game is a science-based Planetary Simulator that combines elements of tower defense, rogue-lite, and classic strategy games.[/p][h2]What to expect:[/h2][p]- Research and implement real-world technologies to monitor space hazards and threats to protect infrastructure on Earth and in space against these dangers.
- Build, improve, and customize satellites and ground-based monitoring systems
- Make strategic and take risk-based decisions under pressure, to respond to dynamic space events – like solar storms, satellite collision events, and asteroid threats

ESA SHIELD is developed as an outreach initiative for the European Space Agency by a collaboration between Steinbeis Transfer GmbH an der Hochschule Darmstadt (h_da) and Technical University of Darmstadt (TU Darmstadt).[/p][p][/p][p]We want to include you as much as possible in the further development of this game. As this is an outreach initiative with fixed project deadlines, we want to get the most out of the game and need your feedback. So leave us a review, start a discussion, or join our Discord. We are looking forward to your feedback![/p][p][/p][p]For us it's time to go back to the Mission Control Room! And the Gamescom! Maybe see you there, we're exhibiting at the Indie Arena Booth Hall 10.2.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.1.17. Notes
notes.content: [h2]SHIELD Mission Update[/h2][p]Hey Earth Defenders![/p][p]Thank you for your feedback, which we collected on Discord, here on Steam, and at our game exhibition at GDD (German Dev Days).[/p][p]Based on your feedback, we have added a few new features, fixed bugs and generally improved the game. We are still in the prototype stage, so expect a few new bugs or unfinished content. That's why we still need more of your feedback![/p][p]Here is a brief overview of what's new, what we have improved, and what we have fixed.[/p][h3][b]New Features [/b]🚀[/h3][list][*][p]New UI design[/p][/*][*][p]Space surveillance (visualisation of monitored areas through telescopes, satellites, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]Quest system[/p][/*][*][p]Spacecraft Creator minigame (assemble satellites, feedback for satellite construction, launch the rocket, etc.)[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Improvements [/b]🔧[/h3][list][*][p]Clicking on an interactive object now centres it.[/p][/*][*][p]Prices for objects have been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]End of service satellites no longer crash directly into Earth.[/p][/*][*][p]Rotating the orbit (for setting satellites or deflection orbits) simplified.[/p][/*][*][p]First tutorial texts implemented.[/p][/*][*][p]New sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Updated narrative texts[/p][/*][*][p]Updated content in the tech tree; tech tree no longer has anything selected by default when opened.[/p][/*][*][p]Drag and drop for constructing buildings; ability to cancel construction; show construction button even when zoomed out.[/p][/*][*][p]The mouse no longer stops at the edge of the screen, but reappears on the other side.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug fixes [/b]🐞[/h3][list][*][p]The X button in the shop no longer opens another UI window, but closes it.[/p][/*][*][p]Building previews are no longer blue in water (blue is the indicator that you can build).[/p][/*][*][p]Mission text adapts to the text frame.[/p][/*][*][p]Menu screens no longer overlap. [/p][/*][/list][p]Do you have any more feedback or have you discovered a new bug? Then join our Discord and let us know! Back to the control room for us – see you soon![/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.1.7. Notes
notes.content: [h2]SHIELD Mission Update[/h2][p]Hey Earth Defenders![/p][p]Thank you for playing and testing the demo. Based on your feedback, we have made initial bug fixes and minor improvements. We have incorporated the more significant feedback into our development process and are working on the features.[/p][p][/p][p]Here's what we've updated so far:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Improvements [/b]🔧[/h3][list][*][p]Made texts on image buttons more visible[/p][/*][*][p]Stopped earth auto rotation on menu open[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased lab info text size to prevent overlapping[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled haptic feedback when primary input is not a gamepad[/p][/*][*][p]Increased vertical earth rotation pitch from 30° to 60° [/p][/*][*][p]Inverted deflection input to match marker movement to orbit rotation[/p][/*][*][p]Made windowed screen default to 16:9 aspect ratio[/p][/*][*][p]Made windowed screen resizable [/p][/*][*][p]Updated the localization files[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes [/b]🐞[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed bug where launching multiple objects all targeted the same orbit[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed orbits not disappearing when empty [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed money not resetting at game restart[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed upgrading for some entities not unlocking after research[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Got any more feedback or spotted a new bug? Feel free to join our Discord and let us know![/p][p][/p][p]Back to the control room for us—talk soon![/p]
